# watchpoint_dns_monitor (Resource)

A DNS monitor that resolves a hostname's records and alerts when the resolved values change or stop matching the expected set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_dns_monitor" "example" {
  name            = "example.com A record"
  hostname        = "example.com"
  record_type     = "A"
  expected_values = "203.0.113.10"
  alert_on_change = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) Hostname to resolve.
- `name` (String) Human-readable monitor name; shown across the UI and alerts.

### Optional

- `alert_on_change` (Boolean) Raise an alert whenever the resolved values change. Defaults to `true`.
- `alert_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls notification channels and routing.
- `check_interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between checks. Defaults to `300`. Plans cap the minimum.
- `compare_nameservers` (Boolean) Query every authoritative nameserver of the zone directly and warn when their answers disagree. Hosted locations only. Defaults to `false`.
- `expected_values` (String) Comma-separated expected record values; a mismatch fails the check.
- `group_id` (String) Monitor group this monitor belongs to.
- `location_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls which regions run the check.
- `nameserver` (String) Specific nameserver to query against; defaults to the resolver's default.
- `record_type` (String) DNS record type to query (e.g. `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `TXT`, `NS`, `CAA`). Defaults to `A`.
- `require_dnssec` (Boolean) Warn unless the answer is DNSSEC-validated (AD flag), asked of `nameserver` or public validating resolvers. Hosted locations only. Defaults to `false`.
- `sla_profile_id` (String) SLA profile attached to this monitor for uptime/latency SLO and error-budget tracking. Requires the SLA monitoring feature.
- `tags` (Set of String) Free-form tags surfaced in filters and SGL queries (`attributes.tags`). Unordered.
- `threshold_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls latency thresholds and consecutive-failure logic.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Resolution timeout in seconds. Defaults to `15`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Monitor ID.
- `last_resolved_values` (String) Most recently resolved values (read-only).
- `status` (String) Current monitor status (e.g. `Active`, `Paused`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_dns_monitor.example mon_dns_001
```
